summary: 2D 平台跳跃设计：跳跃手感（土狼时间、跳跃缓冲、可变高度、下落重力、角落修正）、蹬墙跳、陷阱、存档点和单向平台。 Designs 2D platformers in any engine: jump feel (coyote time, jump buffering, variable height, fall gravity, corner correction), wall jumps, hazards, checkpoints and one-way platforms. Use for a Mario- or Celeste-like, or a jump that feels floaty or laggy. Pair with the engine skill (`godot-2d-movement`, `phaser-arcade-physics`). Not for generic input buffering (`input-systems`) or juice (`game-feel`).
strategy: 先按前置条件安装并通读 skill platformer，规则、数字和检查以它为准；其他游戏开发 skill 不要预装。
Use for a Mario- or Celeste-like, or a jump that feels floaty or laggy.
Workflow: Read the controller first; Pick targets; Derive the constants; Implement the feel core.

需求超出本 skill 时只换装对应的一个，命令 evolver skill fetch --asset <Gene> --out .agents --write：phaser-arcade-physics 用 gene_gdsk_phaser_arcade_physics_v1，input-systems 用 gene_gdsk_input_systems_v1；其余查速查卡 gene_gdsk_index_v1。
